overview: This paper models the late-stage dynamics of SGD as fractional diffusion on porous media characterized by the local learning coefficient from singular learning theory, deriving that the SGD steady-state distribution is a tempered version of the Bayesian posterior weighted by accessibility constraints, and validates this framework across multiple architectures and datasets through displacement scaling analysis and posterior concentration experiments.

modules.name: Dataset Preparation and Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles loading and preprocessing for all datasets used in the paper: MNIST (subset selection, train/test splitting), Moons (generation with configurable noise and sample count), Tiny ImageNet (rescaling, normalization, class-head replacement for fine-tuning), and TinyStories (tokenization and formatting for language model evaluation).

modules.name: Model Architecture Registry
modules.description: Implements and registers all model architectures referenced in experiments: fully connected ReLU networks with batch normalization (variable depth/width), ResNet18/34, VGG11/16, and loading interfaces for pretrained TinyStories-1M, TinyStories-33M, and TinyLlama-15M language models.

modules.name: Local Learning Coefficient Estimator
modules.description: Implements the LLC estimation procedure following the SGLD-based estimator, computing the empirical expectation of loss deviation within a localized ball around a parameter point, with configurable localization radius, SGLD hyperparameters, and burn-in schedule.

modules.name: Weight Displacement Tracker
modules.description: Tracks the Euclidean norm of parameter displacement from initialization over training steps, recording R(t) at regular intervals to characterize the diffusive scaling behavior and detect transitions between super-diffusive and sub-diffusive regimes.

modules.name: Spectral Dimension Estimator
modules.description: Estimates the spectral dimension ds by fitting the log-log linear regression between observed weight displacement and time using the relation log(R(t)) = (ds / (2*lambda(w))) * log(t) + c, with goodness-of-fit (R²) reporting and support for filtering negative-LLC outlier steps.

modules.name: Walk Dimension and Alexander-Orbach Relation
modules.description: Computes the walk dimension dwalk from the empirical displacement scaling R(t) ~ t^(1/dwalk), and validates the Alexander-Orbach relation dwalk = 2*lambda / ds near degenerate critical points, including detection of super-diffusive crossover times.

modules.name: Fractional Fokker-Planck Equation Framework
modules.description: Implements the time-fractional Fokker-Planck equation with Caputo fractional derivative for modeling sub-diffusive SGD dynamics, including the standard FPE baseline, the fractional extension, and numerical solution routines for analyzing how the fractional order alpha relates to the learning coefficient evolution rate.

modules.name: Effective Diffusion Coefficient Computation
modules.description: Implements the fractal effective diffusion coefficient D_xi = xi^(2 - 2*lambda/ds) at a chosen characteristic length scale xi, including validation of the scalar approximation assumption for the diffusion tensor in the large-batch small-learning-rate regime via low-rank Hessian analysis.

modules.name: Steady-State Distribution Derivation
modules.description: Computes the analytical steady-state solution ps(w) proportional to exp(-gamma*L[w]/D_xi) for regions where D_xi is approximately constant, and derives the tempered Bayesian posterior p(w|Xm) = rho(w)*ps(w) / (m*D_xi*Z) relating SGD solutions to the purely Bayesian posterior.

modules.name: SGLD Bayesian Posterior Sampler
modules.description: Implements Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics for approximating the Bayesian posterior over weights, with configurable step size, number of chains, draws, burn-in, and thinning, used as the ground-truth Bayesian reference for comparison with SGD solutions.

modules.name: Tempered Posterior and Distribution Comparison
modules.description: Constructs the tempered SGD distribution by scaling the SGD steady-state by (m*D_xi), then computes distributional distance metrics (KL divergence, Wasserstein distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence) between the tempered SGD distribution and the SGLD Bayesian posterior, with optimal characteristic scale xi selection.

modules.name: Training Pipeline with Multi-Optimizer Support
modules.description: Manages the full training loop supporting SGD (with optional momentum and weight decay) and Adam optimizer, configurable learning rate schedules, batch sizes, and epoch counts, with hooks for displacement tracking and LLC estimation at specified intervals. Includes the fine-tuning protocol (Adam head fitting followed by SGD convergence) for vision models.

modules.name: Diffusive Behavior Validation Experiments
modules.description: Orchestrates experiments validating sub-diffusive dynamics: measuring displacement scaling exponents, verifying the bound ds <= lambda(w(t)) and its time-averaged corollary, fitting power-law models to displacement curves, and comparing predicted vs actual displacement across multiple model-dataset pairs.

modules.name: Posterior Concentration Experiments
modules.description: Runs the core Bayesian correspondence experiment: training many identical networks from random initializations on the Moons dataset with SGD, clustering final solutions, computing LLC for each cluster, comparing concentration of SGD vs SGLD vs tempered-SGD distributions across clusters, and generating the corresponding histograms and concentration bar charts.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Suite
modules.description: Systematically ablates over optimizer type (SGD vs Adam), learning rate, batch size, and momentum; computes correlations between ds, lambda, displacement, and test accuracy for each configuration; generates heatmaps and scatter plots; and includes cross-architecture analysis on FC, convolutional, and residual networks on CIFAR10.
